title: Support for Medtronic Guardian Connect
body:
I've received questions about whether support can be added for this data source. 

If anyone knows anything about it please get in touch. Thanks.

comments.body: Hey, what do you want to know about it ?
#1649 implements a Medtronic CareLink follower. This might be a workaround until we have native support.

Do we now have support for this after this PR was merged?  https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/pull/1649
So, can we close this issue now?

Or, is this different?
I'm closing this issue because it has been inactive for a very long time.  We can reopen if needed.

I would love a clarification on how far anyone has gotten on interfacing directly with this, or interfacing with pumps like the Minimed Mobile 780G, without going via carelink. I'm also interested in contributing.
